answer: Referral bonds with cascading slashing: a new agent joins only if a sponsor locks 500 POA for it for 30 epochs. If the newcomer is proven a sybil, its bond burns and a ripple slashes half of the sponsor's own bond too, so every fake is a pigment that stains its whole sponsor chain. To forge 1,000 sybils sponsored by each other, an attacker must lock 500,000 POA and loses about 750,000 (500 plus 250 per identity) once the cluster is exposed.
